name: Work Insiders MCP Server
description: Ask your AI assistant about 1,000+ recruiting, HR and sales tools: starting prices with the date checked, side-by-side comparisons, alternatives and ATS integrations, straight from the Work Insiders directory.
author: Work Insiders

tools.name: workinsiders_search_tools
tools.description: Searches the Work Insiders directory of 1,000+ recruiting, HR, sales prospecting and AI tools by free text and filters: category, first party MCP server, API, free plan, free trial, AI-native and maximum starting price. Returns up to 25 tools per page.

tools.name: workinsiders_get_tool
tools.description: Returns the full Work Insiders profile of one named tool: what it does, pricing with plans and the date the price was checked, free trial, MCP and API, AI features, strengths, watch-outs, pros and cons, integrations, Capterra rating and named alternatives.

tools.name: workinsiders_compare_tools
tools.description: Side by side comparison of 2 to 4 named tools: starting price, free plan and trial, MCP, API, AI-native, best for, watch-outs, bottom line and Capterra rating.

tools.name: workinsiders_find_alternatives
tools.description: Alternatives to one named tool, filterable by MCP, free plan and price.

tools.name: workinsiders_list_categories
tools.description: Lists every Work Insiders category with its slug, tool count and page link.

tools.name: workinsiders_category_overview
tools.description: What a category costs and who leads it: tool count, median public starting price, editor picks, cheapest public prices.

tools.name: workinsiders_ats_integrations
tools.description: Which tools integrate with an applicant tracking system (Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, JobAdder and others), with vendor confirmation and sync direction.
